name: my-movies-cli
description: A CLI tool for Letterboxd movie recommendations and watchlist management.

scripts.start: npm run chroma:start & wait-on http://localhost:8000/api/v1/heartbeat && node dist/index.js
scripts.dev: npm run chroma:start & wait-on http://localhost:8000/api/v1/heartbeat && NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED='0' ts-node src/index.ts
scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='dist/index.js'; let c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); if(!c.startsWith('#!')){fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c); fs.chmodSync(p,'755');}"
